title: Fernando Mendoza inherits a 4-5 Raiders team and NFL history offers two wildly different outcomes

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Fernando Mendoza inherits a 4-5 Raiders team and NFL history offers two wildly different outcomes
sources.description: Jared Goff lost all seven rookie starts, Lamar Jackson went 6-1 and made the playoffs. Now Mendoza faces the same challenge.
